payment_methods_advertised.description: Every payment method visible anywhere pre-checkout: footer, help pages, PDP, cart. Cards, PayPal, Apple/Google Pay, retailer wallet, BNPL (which provider), EBT/SNAP, HSA/FSA, OTC benefit cards, gift cards, rewards/points.

ebt_snap.description: How/where EBT-SNAP is surfaced (badges, filters, banners), or 'none observed'.

hsa_fsa.description: How/where HSA/FSA eligibility is surfaced, or 'none observed'.

otc.description: How/where OTC benefit-card eligibility is surfaced, or 'none observed'.

use_your_benefits_prompts.description: Any 'use your benefits' / 'shop eligible items' prompts and where they appear.

eligibility_indicators.description: How eligible items are badged/filtered on search and PDP; whether a shopper knows eligibility before checkout.

benefit_tracker.description: Any benefit/balance tracker surfaced pre-checkout, or 'none observed'.

payment_promotions.description: Promotions tied to a payment method: card % back, PayPal offers, BNPL 'as low as $X/mo', membership pricing.

wallet_express_prompts.description: Wallet/express-checkout prompts shown pre-checkout (Apple Pay, Shop Pay, retailer wallet).

savings_surfaced_by_method.description: Whether savings/lowest-cost-by-tender is surfaced proactively or the shopper must discover it.

discovery_effort.description: Qualitative: how much effort for a customer to learn payment/benefit eligibility before checkout.

key_screens_observed.description: Screens visited (home, search, PDP, cart) with a one-line note each.

notable_quotes.description: Exact on-page messaging strings worth quoting in the report.

tasks.label: amazon
tasks.task: You are a payments-UX researcher studying Amazon.com. Do NOT log in, do NOT add to cart beyond what's needed to view messaging, do NOT check out, do NOT buy anything. Study how Amazon communicates PAYMENT and BENEFIT options to shoppers BEFORE checkout. Visit the homepage, search a grocery item ('milk') and a health/OTC item ('allergy relief tablets' or 'FSA eligible'), open 1-2 product detail pages, and view the cart. Capture: every payment method advertised anywhere (footer 'Amazon payment products', help, PDP, cart) including cards, Amazon Pay, Apple/Google Pay, PayPal, Affirm/BNPL, EBT/SNAP (Amazon Fresh), HSA/FSA (Amazon has an FSA/HSA store), OTC, gift cards, points ('Shop with Points'); how EBT/SNAP, HSA/FSA, and OTC eligibility are badged or filtered (look for an 'FSA/HSA eligible' badge/store and 'SNAP EBT eligible' labels); any benefit tracker; payment-linked promotions (card %, 'Shop with Points', BNPL 'as low as'); wallet/express prompts; and how hard it is to know eligibility/savings before checkout. Quote exact on-page text. Return the structured result.

tasks.label: instacart
tasks.task: You are a payments-UX researcher studying Instacart.com. Do NOT log in, do NOT check out, do NOT buy anything (a login wall blocks checkout — that's fine, stay before it). Study how Instacart communicates PAYMENT and BENEFIT options BEFORE checkout. Visit the homepage, pick a retailer storefront (e.g., /store/costco/storefront or a grocery store), search a grocery item ('milk') and a health/OTC item ('allergy' or 'vitamins'), open product pages, and open the cart drawer. Capture: every payment method advertised anywhere (help pages instacart.com/paypal, /p/venmo, /lp/klarna, /help/article/ebt-snap-payments, FSA/HSA help) including cards, Apple/Google Pay, PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Klarna BNPL, EBT/SNAP, HSA/FSA, OTC Network card, Instacart gift cards, Instacart Card Network/points; how EBT/SNAP eligibility is surfaced (SNAP-eligible filter/badges), how HSA/FSA and OTC are surfaced; any 'use your benefits' prompts and benefit tracker; the cart economics messaging (delivery/service fees, $0-fee thresholds, order minimum); payment-linked promotions; and effort to learn eligibility before checkout. Quote exact on-page text. Return the structured result.

tasks.label: costco
tasks.task: You are a payments-UX researcher studying Costco.com. Do NOT log in, do NOT check out, do NOT buy anything. Study how Costco communicates PAYMENT and BENEFIT options to shoppers BEFORE checkout. Visit the homepage, search a grocery item ('milk') and a health item ('vitamins' or visit the Pharmacy/Optical or FSA-eligible area if present), open 1-2 product pages, and view the cart. Capture: every payment method advertised anywhere (help/'online payment methods' page, footer, PDP, cart) including which cards (note Costco's Visa-only in-warehouse but broader online), Costco Anywhere Visa, Affirm/BNPL online, Apple/Google Pay, digital wallets, Costco Shop Cards (gift), and whether EBT/SNAP, HSA/FSA, or OTC are accepted or mentioned; how membership pricing/savings are surfaced; any benefit or eligibility badging; payment-linked promotions; wallet/express prompts; and how hard it is to learn eligibility/savings before checkout. Note membership gating. Quote exact on-page text. Return the structured result.

tasks.label: shopify_allbirds
tasks.task: You are a payments-UX researcher studying Allbirds.com, used as a REPRESENTATIVE Shopify merchant to characterize the Shopify/Shop Pay checkout stack. Do NOT log in, do NOT complete checkout, do NOT buy anything (you may proceed to the checkout/payment screen to observe methods, then stop). Study how a typical Shopify storefront communicates PAYMENT options to shoppers BEFORE and at checkout. Add an item to cart and open the cart/checkout. Capture: every payment method advertised (cards, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Amazon Pay, Shop Pay Installments / Affirm BNPL 'as low as $X/mo'); the express-checkout / accelerated-checkout buttons shown on the cart and checkout (Shop Pay, Apple Pay, etc.); how Shop Pay is promoted (one-click, saved info, installments messaging); whether any benefit tenders (EBT/SNAP, HSA/FSA, OTC) are offered (likely none — note that explicitly, as it characterizes DTC Shopify vs retailers); payment-linked promotions; and the overall discovery effort. Quote exact on-page text. Return the structured result.
